details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K5, and K6 are PRESENT with supporting evidence in the candidate. K4 (country-specific investment property fair value developments) and K7 (sustainability performance) are MISSING entirely. The summary captures most core financial and operational metrics but lacks detailed country-level property value changes and sustainability KPIs, resulting in a Generally yes rating due to substantial but incomplete coverage.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected, with no self-contradictions. Explanations for changes in financial metrics (e.g., NOI increase due to cost controls, profit increase due to gains) are consistent throughout. The organization follows a logical flow from operational performance to financial results, risk indicators, and external assessments. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between figures and explanations are clear and internally consistent. Differences between segment and consolidated figures are not presented as additive components of the same total, so they do not constitute contradictions under the specified evaluation criteria.
